test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

BLOCK : LBPKC :: MARGIN : ?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**First letters are arranged in reverse order.**

**And then letters are increased or decreased by +1 or -1 alternatively.**

Given:

BLOCK : LBPKC

__
 
• BLOCK → Reverse order → KCOLB.
 
• Now letters are increased or decreased by +1 or -1 alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/280a0ebe8d2d6a232363695e48fbc260b212f887d26090d21306598ae7fdaa76.png] 

Similarly,

**MARGIN = ?**

 
• MARGIN **→ Reverse order → NIGRAM.**
 
• **Now letters are increased or decreased by +1 or -1 alternatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0be9d1b37851356e2cef0bbe9c3a9c93a2ac46feaa1018c8c5c696be6d459acc.png] 

 

Hence, 'MARGIN' is coded as "**OHHQBL**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8843d5009d7fc98be188253fe8b525b9668391ce497ce2a67deaf3e20ab00830.png]
